wordCountMethod: Whitespace-separated paragraph, practical-step and code words; section titles excluded.
reviewMethod: Every new paragraph, step and code sample compared semantically with actual full training-unit text and consulted current official product-document text. Worked scenarios are original illustrations, not copied Microsoft assessments. Azure operations were not executed.
